mappings.quote: Team members may be from inside or outside the manufacturer

requirements.item_text: Self-inspection team members are free from bias.

mappings.quote: members of the team should be free from bias.

requirements.item_text: Self-inspections can cover areas such as premises, personnel, equipment, maintenance and calibration, storage conditions of materials and finished products, production and in-process controls, quality control, documentation and data integrity, change control and deviations, complaints and recalls, qualification and validation, and cleaning procedures.

mappings.quote: Areas to be covered in self-inspections may include: ■ premises ■ personnel ■ equipment ■ maintenance and calibration ■ storage conditions of materials and finished products ■ production and in-process controls ■ quality control ■ documentation, data generation and data integrity ■ change control and deviations management ■ complaints and recalls ■ qualification and validation ■ cleaning procedures.

requirements.item_text: The self-inspection programme is designed to find any gaps in how GMP is implemented and to recommend the corrective actions needed.

mappings.quote: The self-inspection programme should be designed to detect any shortcomings in the implementation of GMP and to rec- ommend the necessary corrective actions.

requirements.item_text: Self-inspections are carried out routinely.

mappings.quote: Self-inspections should be performed routinely

requirements.item_text: Additional self-inspections can be carried out on special occasions, for example after product recalls or repeated rejections, or when a health authority inspection is announced.

mappings.quote: may be, in addition, performed on special occasions, e.g. in the case of product recalls or repeated rejections, or when an inspection by the health authorities is announced

requirements.item_text: The self-inspection team is made up of people able to assess GMP implementation objectively.

mappings.quote: The team responsible for self-inspection should consist of personnel who can evaluate the implementation of GMP objectively

requirements.item_text: All recommended corrective actions from self-inspection are implemented.

mappings.quote: all recommenda- tions for corrective action should be implemented

requirements.item_text: The self-inspection procedure is documented.

mappings.quote: The procedure for self-inspection should be documented

requirements.item_text: An effective follow-up programme for self-inspections is in place.

mappings.quote: there should be an effec- tive follow-up programme

requirements.item_text: Written self-inspection instructions are established that set a minimum, uniform standard of requirements.

mappings.quote: Written instructions for self-inspection should be established to provide a minimum and uniform standard of requirements.

requirements.item_text: Self-inspection instructions can include GMP questionnaires covering at least: personnel; premises including personnel facilities; maintenance of buildings and equipment; storage of starting materials and finished products; equipment; production and in-process controls; quality control; documentation; sanitation and hygiene; validation and revalidation programmes; calibration of instruments or measurement systems; recall procedures; complaints management; labels control; and results of earlier self-inspections and corrective steps taken.

mappings.quote: These may include questionnaires on GMP requirements covering at least the following items: (a) personnel (b) premises including personnel facilities (c) maintenance of buildings and equipment (d) storage of starting materials and finished products (e) equipment (f) production and in-process controls (g) quality control (h) documentation (i) sanitation and hygiene (j) validation and revalidation programmes (k) calibration of instruments or measurements systems (l) recall procedures (m) complaints management (n) labels control (o) results of previous self-inspections and any corrective steps taken.

requirements.item_text: Management appoints a self-inspection team of local staff who are experts in their own fields and familiar with GMP.

mappings.quote: Management should appoint a self-inspection team from local staff who are expert in their own fields and familiar with GMP.

requirements.item_text: Self-inspection team members can be appointed from inside or outside the company.

mappings.quote: The members of the team may be appointed from inside or outside the company.

requirements.item_text: The site can set how often self-inspections are done according to company requirements.

mappings.quote: The frequency at which self-inspections are conducted may de- pend on company requirements.

requirements.item_text: A report is prepared when each self-inspection is completed.

mappings.quote: A report should be made at the completion of a self-inspection.

requirements.item_text: The self-inspection report contains the results, the evaluation and conclusions, and the recommended corrective actions.

mappings.quote: The report should include: (a) self-inspection results (b) evaluation and conclusions (c) recommended corrective actions.

requirements.item_text: Company management evaluates the self-inspection report and the corrective actions, as necessary.

mappings.quote: The company management should evaluate both the self- inspection report and the corrective actions as necessary.

requirements.item_text: The site can supplement self-inspections with a quality audit.

mappings.quote: It may be useful to supplement self-inspections with a quality audit.
